actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Draw a completely NEW SINGLE full-body FRONT Bunny character on white, Japanese hand-drawn dark lineart + clean CEL colours. Entire person from hair crown to both shoe soles, no panels/text/labels. This is a fresh whole figure, NOT a pasted composite.
EXACTLY TWO RESPONSIBILITIES:
REFERENCE1 is a RECTANGULAR ORIGINAL-PIXEL CROP of the ACCEPTED clothed BODY, with no head in this crop. Original source canvas was1024x1536; crop rectangle is[0,275,1024,1536], so the visible crop is1024x1261 and its top corresponds to original y275. Preserve all original body/garment/equipment shape, proportions and pose. In the NEW FULL FIGURE reconstruct the head and appropriate top margin above this body; do not treat the cropped body's height as the entire person and do not compress the legs.
REFERENCE2 is the ONLY COMPLETE HEAD + CORRECTLY CENTERED GOGGLES authority. Copy its human face/hair/blue eyes/natural ears AND the already-correct relationship between goggle nose relief and face center as one coherent HEAD design. Do not independently reposition the goggles according to a different head, hair part, or generic skull. There is no second head authority. Its hair part is visibly OFFSET from its nose/chin axis; keep this offset while goggles align with the FACE, not cowlick.
Preserve head/body proportion: reference1 original human head occupied hair-crown near y25 to chin near y250 (about225px high) on its1024x1536 layout, with neck joining current collar near y278. Fit ref2 HEAD design at that same proportional size ABOVE the neck-down crop, restoring the complete person's original head/body ratio. Do not enlarge the closeup into a giant head, do not shrink the body/lengthen waist/shorten legs. Head and face stay straight-on, no roll, no shifting facial features.
CRITICAL mirror relation carried from ref2: goggle central NASAL RELIEF and midpoint of the TWO ORANGE connectors are vertically over the pupil midpoint → nose → philtrum → chin. Corresponding rim/connector points are level relative to the eye baseline and equidistant from that FACE axis. Do NOT use the off-center hair part or outer hair silhouette to center the frame. At original layout the real face axis is around x515, not x505; goggle center must follow the real face. Preserve compact raised goggles: same softly rounded thin white rim/one smoke lens/charcoal inner gasket/two small orange side connectors/one slender black ELASTIC strap wrapping side and back. No rigid arm/hinge, no crown beam/headband, no rabbit ears/roots, no headset/ear pads/pods/microphone. Entire ordinary goggles sits on forehead above eyebrows, both blue eyes completely visible, nose/mouth free. A slight fore-to-aft resting pitch is fine; no left-right roll or side shift.
Retain REF1 clothing absolutely: normal black fine-rib collar/cuffs, white collar/chest opening/hem, orange cropped jacket long front tips/short back, red lapel facings, small connected WHITE OG at character LEFT sleeve pocket with margin. INTERNAL harness stays outside white top but under jacket: single black chest band/SILVER chest clasp visible only in the open front, no shoulder webbing on orange cloth. Two tail hooks to front orange waist anchors. Black belt through original red shorts loops, BLACK waist clasp, no extra pants button; same shorts waist/crotch/pockets/rolled hem. Character right = viewerLEFT: red wrist and full black glove, two right-thigh units, short white sock. Character left = viewerRIGHT: orange wrist screen with readable cyan UI, fingerless black glove, orange long sock. Same detailed red/white/black boots and screen symbols, do not erase/reinvent them.
Material/style consistent with clean ref2: silver-white hair with coherent cool-gray shapes/dark ink, no flesh-coloured locks/floating ears/blue-gray noisy shine. Peach skin with hard controlled shade. Orange fabric flat areas + bounded hard shadows; fine rib only actual knit cuffs/collar/sock cuff, not cloudy streaks on white sock shaft. No white-speck artifacts, muddied grain, haze or waxy skin. No extra accessories, no weapon, no labels. New complete tool-generated illustration only.

drawing_limitations: 新正面鞋的纵向图面投影相对前稿略长；独立审阅估计归一后约增8–10%，鞋宽、鞋型与构件保留。此为已接受的绘图差异，不是新的尺寸规范，也不声称整人仅作等比例变换。
